title: EuroDocsBot
author: EuDocs
content:
This web crawler was built by Charles Toronto on behalf of the Brigham Young University HBLL EuroDocs Project in 2021. The EuroDocs Project is a compilation of freely accessible online primary source records for the countries of Europe. The purpose of the bot is to scan the EuroDocs subdomain for broken links to external sites and compile them into a site maintenance list for Dr. Richard Hacken, manager of the project.

The only information that this bot collects from external links is the URL and HTTP status code. If you would prefer that the bot not crawl your website, please contact us so that we can add an exception to the bot.

Dr. Richard Hacken

eurodocs @ byu.edu
